Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Technical Account Management, Support and Services (TAMSS) supports Stripe’s largest, fastest-growing, and most strategically important users through our paid support offerings.

Technical Account Managers serve as trusted advisers to users and account teams. They combine an understanding of a user’s business, Stripe integration, technical architecture, and strategic priorities to improve integration performance and resilience, lead complex engagements, and coordinate Stripe’s response to critical issues.

The EMEA organization supports direct merchants and platforms across a diverse set of markets, industries, and technical environments. The team partners closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Support, Professional Services, and Solutions Architecture.

What you’ll do

As Head of Technical Account Management for Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA), you will own the regional direction and performance of TAMSS, including teams supporting Stripe’s largest direct merchants and platforms.

You’ll translate Stripe’s global priorities into regional plans that reflect EMEA’s markets, users, and commercial opportunities. Your remit will include user outcomes, service quality, paid support growth, organizational health, and the effective allocation of TAM capacity.

You’ll also serve as an executive partner for strategically important users and represent EMEA on the global TAMSS leadership team. Insights from the region will inform how Stripe develops its products, services, and approach to supporting complex users around the world.

Responsibilities

  • Set and execute the multi-year strategy and operating model for EMEA TAMSS.
  • Lead and scale a substantial, distributed EMEA Technical Account Management organization, developing a strong management layer across multiple markets, user segments, and technical domains.
  • Own regional outcomes across paid support growth, service delivery, strategic-user health, technical impact, and organizational performance.
  • Determine the regional organization and coverage model, including leadership structure, market coverage, capacity allocation, and investment priorities.
  • Partner with senior leaders across Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Support, Professional Services, and Solutions Architecture to deliver coordinated outcomes for users.
  • Work with go-to-market leaders on paid support adoption, renewals, account strategy, staffing, and the sustainable growth of Stripe’s services business.
  • Build trusted relationships with executive technical and business leaders at Stripe’s largest users, serving as a senior escalation point when needed.
  • Provide executive oversight for high-impact user escalations and critical support incidents, ensuring clear ownership, rapid coordination, timely communication, and effective resolution, translating learnings into support experience improvements.
  • Use user feedback, commercial insights, and operational data to identify risks, improve performance, and inform investment decisions.
  • Turn patterns from complex user engagements into improvements to Stripe’s products, services, and operating models.
  • Hire and develop managers, set clear expectations, and build a strong succession pipeline for critical leadership roles.
  • Represent EMEA in global TAMSS planning and develop approaches that can be adopted across other regions.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 15+ years of experience in technical account management, solutions architecture, customer success, or related user-facing technical functions, including 6+ years managing people and experience managing managers.
  • A track record of leading substantial, distributed organizations through multiple organizational layers, developing managers, and retaining strong management and technical talent.
  • Experience setting multi-year strategy and translating it into organizational plans, investment decisions, and measurable user and business outcomes.
  • Experience building trusted relationships with executive business and technical leaders at large and strategically important users.
  • Strong technical and commercial judgment, including the ability to understand complex integrations, assess user and service-delivery risks, and work effectively with Product and Engineering leaders.
  • Demonstrated success aligning senior leaders with different priorities around a shared strategy.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with P&L management, budget ownership, or operating in a General Manager (GM) capacity for a regional services organization.
  • Experience leading a technical services organization across multiple EMEA markets.
  • Experience growing and delivering paid technical services, support plans, or another recurring services offering.
  • Experience in financial technology, payments, Software as a Service, or API-based products.
  • Experience supporting global enterprises or platforms with complex technical and operational environments.
descriptions.job-1wv3k7h:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.

What you’ll be part of:

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What you'll be responsible for:

Own end-to-end accounting for revenue and partner arrangements, ensuring accurate recognition, timely close, and complete disclosures across customer and partner incentives. Maintain and improve internal controls and reporting, partner with commercial, legal, tax, and data teams to define accounting and control requirements, and support internal and external audits. Identify, design, and implement AI and automation solutions — including generative models such as ChatGPT and Gemini — to reduce manual work, improve quality, and preserve human oversight and audit readiness.

What you'll work on:


  • Own month end and quarter end close for revenue and partnership arrangements, including subledger reviews, journal entries, account reconciliations, investigation and resolution of reconciling items, and related controls.
  • Analyse balance sheet and P&L movements, investigate anomalies and provide clear, evidence based commentary on key drivers, including timely review and circulation of the revenue flash.
  • Partner with FinOps and Product teams on new and evolving products, proactively reviewing product documentation and transaction and fund flows to identify accounting implications and define accounting, data, system, control and reporting requirements ahead of launch.
  • Review customer and partner arrangements and apply ASC 606 and other relevant U.S. GAAP to complex or non standard terms, documenting conclusions in clear, audit ready accounting memos.
  • Review expected credit loss provisions and underlying assumptions, ensuring estimates are appropriately supported, documented and reflected in the financial statements.
  • Partner with FinOps, Product, Billing, Legal, Tax, Data and Engineering teams to translate accounting conclusions and requirements into scalable processes, systems, controls and reporting.
  • Own the accounting for customer and partner incentives, including understanding end-to-end process and data flows, validating incentive calculations against contractual terms and supporting data, and recording appropriate accruals, true-ups, and journal entries with clear documentation and controls.
  • Take end to end ownership of assigned areas, proactively resolving issues, maintaining high quality documentation and audit readiness, and identifying AI and automation opportunities that simplify processes, strengthen controls and reduce manual work while maintaining appropriate human judgement and governance.

What you'll bring to Circle:

Core requirements:

  • 4+ years of relevant accounting, revenue or audit experience with ACA, CPA, ACCA or equivalent professional accounting qualification.
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and/or IFRS, particularly ASC 606 / IFRS 15, with hands-on experience applying revenue recognition guidance to complex and judgemental arrangements.
  • Strong technical accounting and problem solving skills, with the ability to understand new products and commercial arrangements, assess their accounting implications and translate conclusions into clear accounting and system requirements.
  • Strong systems and data mindset, with the ability to understand transaction and fund flows across systems, investigate complex datasets and identify and resolve process, data or accounting gaps.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare high quality accounting memos and explain complex accounting matters clearly to Finance and non Finance stakeholders.
  • High ownership, attention to detail and quality standards, with the ability to take end to end responsibility for accounting processes, controls and audit readiness with limited oversight.
  • Hands-on experience using AI, automation or data tools to solve problems and improve processes, with a strong drive to simplify and automate work while maintaining appropriate judgement, governance and controls.

Preferred requirements:

  • Experience in payments, crypto, banking or technology companies
  • Experience with Oracle fusion or other similar ERP systems and transaction subledgers (Oracle or similar)
  • Experience/familiarity with Slack, Apple MacOS and GSuite

THE WORK:

Ripple Treasury (formerly GTreasury) is the leading innovator of integrated SaaS treasury and risk management solutions for the digital treasurer. Built on the latest technology, Ripple Treasury helps organizations move toward strategic treasury by giving them total visibility into their cash, liquidity, payments and financial risk management.

At Ripple Treasury, we believe data-driven decisions are the heartbeat of a successful enterprise. As a Senior Professional Services Consultant based in São Paulo, you'll be our senior advisor to clients across Brazil and Latin America. You'll lead our most complex implementations from start to finish: multi-entity, multi-currency and multi-bank. You'll be the person clients and colleagues turn to for answers. Your job is to understand each client's business, show them best practice, and design solutions that turn their treasury operations into a real advantage. You'll also help build our delivery capability in the region and mentor the consultants around you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Engagement Leadership: Own delivery of complex, high-value implementations end to end, from kickoff through go-live and hypercare. You'll be accountable for scope, quality, timelines and client satisfaction.
  • Discovery & Strategy: Run executive-level discovery with CFOs, Treasurers and Controllers. You'll uncover pain points, map current-state workflows and define measurable success criteria.
  • Solution Architecture: Design and document the "To-Be" state across Ripple Treasury's full suite (cash, liquidity, payments, risk and accounting), including integrations with banks, ERPs and market data providers.
  • Trusted Advisory: Act as a recognized treasury subject matter expert. You'll guide clients through best practice, challenge legacy processes and help them build the business case for change.
  • Regional Expertise: Bring deep knowledge of the Brazilian and LATAM treasury landscape, including local banking formats and local regulatory and tax considerations. You'll turn this knowledge into repeatable delivery patterns.
  • Hands-On Configuration: Configure the platform yourself on complex workstreams. You'll also set configuration standards and review the work of other consultants.
  • Mentorship & Team Development: Coach and mentor Professional Services Consultants, lead peer reviews, and help build out Ripple Treasury's delivery team in the region.
  • Escalation Management: Serve as the senior point of contact for difficult client situations. You'll resolve issues quickly and protect the relationship.
  • Enablement & Training: Run high-impact training and train-the-trainer sessions in English, Portuguese and, where needed, Spanish, so clients get the most value from the platform.
  • Cross-Functional Influence: Work with Product, Engineering and Sales to feed LATAM market requirements and client insight into the product roadmap.
  • Methodology & IP: Help improve our implementation methodology, templates and best-practice playbooks.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • 6+ years of experience in client-facing solution consulting and/or enterprise software implementations, specifically in Treasury Management Systems (TMS), ERP or financial SaaS
  • Languages: Fluent English and Portuguese, written and spoken. Spanish is a strong plus.
  • Proven Engagement Leadership: A track record of leading complex, multi-entity or multinational implementations as the primary consultant or workstream lead
  • Consultative Mindset: You don't just take orders. You ask "why," challenge the status quo with confidence, and lead senior stakeholders toward better outcomes.
  • Technical Depth: Hands-on experience with complex software ecosystems and a strong understanding of how data flows between treasury systems, banks and ERPs. Familiarity with bank connectivity (SWIFT, host-to-host, APIs) and file formats.
  • Treasury Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of cash management, cash forecasting, payments, FX and financial risk, and/or hedge accounting
  • Financial Fluency: Experience working with or within Corporate Treasury, Accounting and/or Finance. You're comfortable discussing cash flow, debt, investments, intercompany and financial risk with executive audiences.
  • Executive Communication: You can translate "tech-speak" into "CFO-speak" and make complex financial and technical concepts clear and compelling.
  • Leadership & Mentorship: Experience coaching or mentoring junior consultants and raising the quality of the team's work
  • Travel: Willingness to travel to client sites across Brazil and Latin America as needed

WHO WE ARE:

Do Your Best Work

  • The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders
  • A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact.  A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.
  • Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.
  • In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in. 
  • Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team
  • We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!

Take Control of Your Finances

  • Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity
  • Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support
  • Employee giving match
  • Mobile phone stipend

Take Care of Yourself

  • R&R days so you can rest and recharge
  • Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming
  • Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it
  • Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.
  • Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events

Benefits listed above are for full-time employees.

It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. The Role

We build AI products, and the quality of our evaluations sets the ceiling for how good those products can be. The speed of our evaluations determines how quickly we can improve them.

We are looking for an engineer to build the infrastructure and tooling that make high-quality AI evaluation possible at Block's scale. You will help teams understand whether a model or product change is actually better, whether a result is statistically meaningful, and whether offline evaluation is predicting what happens with real users.

Our evaluation approach combines offline evals that encode our definition of a good response, online evals that show how people actually respond, and a feedback loop that keeps the two converging. Your work will turn that approach into systems that product teams can use quickly, reliably, and with confidence.

This is a high-impact, early-stage area with broad surface area. You will help decide what to build first, then build the platform that helps teams ship better AI products faster.

You Will

  • Build an execution engine that can score candidate versions against task sets in minutes, not hours.
  • Create task set tooling that samples from production logs and validates tasks before they are admitted into an evaluation set.
  • Build grader infrastructure across ground truth checks, rubrics, and LLM-as-judge approaches.
  • Develop tooling that helps human reviewers calibrate judges, measure judge-to-human agreement, and monitor drift over time.
  • Build leaderboards and reporting systems that include sample size, confidence intervals, and run-to-run variance, so teams can distinguish real improvements from noise.
  • Support in-product side-by-side serving, feedback capture, and implicit signal extraction from real conversations.
  • Build the loop that compares offline scores with online outcomes, identifies eval sets that have stopped predicting reality, and helps teams improve them.
  • Partner with product, engineering, data, and ML teams to make evaluation workflows fast enough and trustworthy enough to become part of everyday development.

You Have

  • Experience building production platforms or infrastructure, including distributed batch execution, data pipelines, or systems that process production logs.

AI product development moves quickly, but speed only helps when teams can trust the signal they are using to make decisions.
